requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).

requirements.name: transparent-background
requirements.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.

requirements.name: ready-meaning
requirements.check: Viewed alone, the image reads as successful completion (Ready) rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.

requirements.name: asymmetric-check-mark
requirements.check: At 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale on #172336, the mark is visibly a check mark whose two arms are visibly asymmetrical (for example differing in length and/or angle), so that it reads as successful completion. The criterion does not fix the arm ratio, orientation (left/right), stroke weight or colour; a symmetric V, a cross, a circle-only badge or an indistinct blob fails.

requirements.name: readability-1x-3x
requirements.check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail lost into the panel colour.

requirements.name: cool-blue-accent
requirements.check: The dominant colour treatment visibly relates to the existing UI's cool blue accent as seen in assets/start.svg (#70b9ed). This is a visual relationship judgement, not an exact-hex or palette-count rule.

requirements.name: silhouette-without-color
requirements.check: In a grayscale/desaturated view at 1x and 3x, the Ready mark still has a distinct identifiable shape (its meaning is carried by form, not only hue).

requirements.name: sample-pixel-craft
requirements.check: As a representative family sample, the image shows deliberate pixel-art construction: clean pixel clusters and edges, no noisy stray pixels, blur or downscaled-illustration artifacts, and a treatment that could plausibly be extended to Working, Retry and Paused.
